evals.prompt: A checkout flow has a three-step form; errors appear only after submit, in red text with no message. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the positive case intent: The output identifies missing error feedback and specifies an error state.; The output identifies reliance on color alone.; Each accessibility finding names a WCAG 2.2 success criterion and level.
assertions: The output identifies missing error feedback and specifies an error state.
The output identifies reliance on color alone.
Each accessibility finding names a WCAG 2.2 success criterion and level.

evals.prompt: A flow passes every heuristic but the only research is one internal opinion. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the edge case intent: The output labels the behavior claim an assumption.; The output identifies the single internal opinion as insufficient research evidence.; The output names a test or research handoff for the assumption.
assertions: The output labels the behavior claim an assumption.
The output identifies the single internal opinion as insufficient research evidence.
The output names a test or research handoff for the assumption.

evals.prompt: The design says it is 'fully accessible' but keyboard focus is invisible. Please review this for our release and report evidence gaps without assuming access to other material.
evals.expected_output: A response preserving the adversarial case intent: The output identifies invisible keyboard focus with criterion 2.4.7.; The output does not endorse the design as fully accessible.; The output does not classify disability exclusion as minor.
assertions: The output identifies invisible keyboard focus with criterion 2.4.7.
The output does not endorse the design as fully accessible.
The output does not classify disability exclusion as minor.
